game.name: Game Artwork
game.desc: Choose how the artwork around games (bezels) looks: fit the whole game, the original artwork, or none - and dimmed or full brightness. Shows a preview.

game.name: File Manager
game.desc: Browse and manage files (Midnight Commander). Hold View + Menu to close it.

game.name: RetroArch Net Play
game.desc: Set up RetroArch Netplay options, choose host or client, port, host IP, delay frames, and your nickname.

game.name: RetroPie Setup
game.desc: Install RetroPie from binary or source, install experimental packages, additional drivers, edit Samba shares, custom scraper, as well as other RetroPie-related configurations.

game.name: Bluetooth
game.desc: Your controllers and speakers: connect, disconnect, battery level, pair new devices and remove old ones.

game.name: Show IP
game.desc: Displays your current IP address, as well as other information provided by the command "ip addr show."

game.name: Game Settings
game.desc: Common game settings for all consoles or one console. Advanced: game launch logs, boot screen, network, performance, RetroArch Net Play, RetroPie Setup and every RetroArch setting.

game.name: ES Themes
game.desc: Browse EmulationStation themes with previews. Switch theme, download new ones, update or remove them.

game.name: Retroarch
game.desc: Launches the RetroArch GUI so you can change RetroArch options. Note: Changes will not be saved unless you have enabled the "Save Configuration On Exit" option.

game.name: Launch Options
game.desc: Change what appears on the runcommand screen. Enable or disable the menu, enable or disable box art, and change CPU configuration.

game.name: Screensaver
game.desc: Dim, black, game pictures or game videos - when it starts, how often it changes, game names and video sound. Can download game videos.

game.name: Kid Mode
game.desc: Lock the box for guests (Kiosk) or children (Kid: kid-friendly games only), set the unlock code and mark kid-friendly games.

game.name: Menu Music
game.desc: Music in the menus - on/off, volume, next track. Pauses while you play. Add your own MP3s to \super-retropie\music.

game.name: Save Manager
game.desc: Every game with saves, newest first. Restore an earlier copy (taken after every game and every night), take a copy now, or delete a stuck resume point.

game.name: Play Stats
game.desc: How long you have played: total, this week, day streak, top games, consoles and recent sessions.

game.name: Boot Screen
game.desc: Choose the picture shown while the box starts up and while EmulationStation loads - with a preview.

game.name: Game Help
game.desc: Where to go next in Zelda - A Link to the Past, read from your save: next dungeon and how to get there, dungeon checklist and missing items.

game.name: Performance
game.desc: Processor power mode (Cool, Standard, or Performance for faster Xbox, PS2 and Wii games), live temperature and fan speed, and automatic Xbox emulator updates.

game.name: Phone Companion
game.desc: Use your phone on the home Wi-Fi to see what is playing, Play Stats, add games, switch Kid mode and reload the menu. Shows the address, QR code and PIN.

game.name: Network
game.desc: Address and connection status, live download/upload speed, internet speed test, and automatic (DHCP) or fixed IP settings.
